story: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price SBIN to move about ±5.5%, roughly 1,070 to 1,194. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 59% of the time.

Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap +0.5 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for SBIN: against the past year the gap is on the high side, so less fear is priced than usual.
SBIN futures trade 7.8 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 7.9% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
SBIN has actually been moving about 1.57% a day this past month: normal for it against the past year.

iv.simple: Options on SBIN are priced for moves of about 1.47% a day. That is normal for SBIN compared with the past year.
iv.analyst: 30-day constant-maturity ATM IV 23.3%: 59th percentile of 1 year, 28th of all days since 2019-01-01.

vrp.simple: Options are cheap compared with how much SBIN has actually been moving: they price 23.3% a year while the last month realised 24.8%.
vrp.analyst: IV30 - RV21 = -1.6 vol points, 33rd percentile of the past year. Since 2019-01-01, IV30 was above the volatility that actually followed over the next 21 sessions on 73% of days: option sellers are usually paid a premium for carrying the risk, and the gap is what that premium looks like today.

term.simple: Near and far options on SBIN are priced about the same: nothing special is expected soon.

skew.simple: Calls and puts the same distance from the price cost about the same (gap +0.5 vol points): no strong demand for either protection or upside. Puts usually cost more than this for SBIN: against the past year the gap is on the high side, so less fear is priced than usual.
skew.analyst: 25-delta risk reversal +0.47 vol pts (front month), 87th percentile of the past year. More negative = more demand for downside insurance relative to upside.

realised.simple: SBIN has actually been moving about 1.57% a day this past month: normal for it against the past year.
realised.analyst: RV21 24.8% (70th percentile of the past year), RV5 23.2%, RV63 22.2%; RV5/RV63 compression at the 66th percentile.

oi.simple: For the 2026-12-29 expiry, the biggest pile of call positions is at 1,200 (+6.8% away) and the biggest pile of put positions is at 1,100 (-2.1%). Option sellers defend these levels, so price often slows near them, but they shift as positions change.
oi.analyst: Front-expiry PCR (OI) 0.73; all-expiry OI PCR at the 37th percentile of the past year. Today's change: calls +4,848,000, puts +1,674,750 (OI units, i.e. shares or index quantity). A high PCR in India mostly reflects put writing, so it is read as crowding, not as a signal.

futures.simple: SBIN futures trade 7.8 points above the price itself. That premium works out to 7.9% a year, within its usual range for the past year.
futures.analyst: Near-month basis +7.8, annualised carry 7.9% (83rd percentile of the past year; its 1-year median 6.1%). Last 5 sessions (price x OI, same contracts day to day): Long build-up, Short build-up, Long build-up, Long unwinding, Long unwinding. Build-up labels describe what happened to positions; they do not say who is right.

move.simple: Until 2026-12-29 (32 days), options price SBIN to move about ±5.5%, roughly 1,070 to 1,194. In the past, the price ended inside the range priced this way 59% of the time.
move.analyst: ATM straddle / forward = 5.46% (forward 1,131.9). Scored on 1,956 days since 2019-01-01 against the official close on each expiry; a straddle is the market's mean absolute move, so about 57% inside is what a fair price would give.

notes.text: SBIN has used 19% of its market-wide position limit (the ban starts at 95%).
